استعمرتا (form X)
# اِسْتَعْمَرَتَا (istaʕmaratā) /is.taʕ.ma.ra.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِسْتَعْمَرَ (istaʕmara)
# اُسْتُعْمِرَتَا (ustuʕmiratā) /us.tuʕ.mi.ra.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِسْتَعْمَرَ (istaʕmara)
